speaker: dad
igboText: Nwa nwa m nwanyị, ị ma ihe kpatara anwụnta ji eme ụzụ n'akụkụ ntị?
englishText: Granddaughter, do you know why mosquitoes buzz near ears?
statement: Dad asks his granddaughter if she knows why mosquitoes buzz near ears.
falseStatement: Dad asks his granddaughter why birds sing near ears.

speaker: granddaughter
igboText: Mba, Nnaochie. Gịnị mere ha ji eme ya?
englishText: No, Grandpa. Why do they do that?
statement: The granddaughter says she does not know and asks why mosquitoes do that.
falseStatement: The granddaughter says she already knows why.

speaker: dad
igboText: N'oge gara aga, Anwụnta chọrọ ịlụ Ntị.
englishText: Long ago, Mosquito wanted to marry Ear.
statement: Dad says that long ago Mosquito wanted to marry Ear.
falseStatement: Dad says long ago Ear wanted to marry Mosquito.

speaker: granddaughter
englishText: Did Ear want to marry him?
statement: The granddaughter asks whether Ear wanted to marry Mosquito.
falseStatement: The granddaughter asks whether Mosquito wanted to marry Ear.

speaker: dad
igboText: Mba. Ntị jụrụ ya ma gawa.
englishText: No. Ear said no and walked away.
statement: Dad says Ear refused and walked away.
falseStatement: Dad says Ear agreed and stayed.

speaker: granddaughter
igboText: Gịnị ka Anwụnta mere mgbe ahụ?
statement: The granddaughter asks what Mosquito did next.
falseStatement: The granddaughter asks what Ear did next.

speaker: dad
igboText: Ọ nọgidere na-abịa azụ ma na-ajụ ọzọ.
englishText: He kept coming back and asking again.
statement: Dad says Mosquito kept returning and asking again.
falseStatement: Dad says Mosquito stopped coming back.

speaker: granddaughter
statement: The granddaughter asks whether Ear changed her mind.
falseStatement: The granddaughter asks whether Mosquito changed his mind.

speaker: dad
igboText: Mba. Ntị gwụrụ ike n'ịnụ ya.
englishText: No. Ear grew tired of hearing him.
statement: Dad says Ear became tired of hearing Mosquito.
falseStatement: Dad says Ear enjoyed hearing Mosquito.

speaker: granddaughter
statement: The granddaughter asks what happened after that.
falseStatement: The granddaughter asks what happened before that.

speaker: dad
igboText: Anwụnta malitere iso ndị mmadụ, ka ọ na-ajụkwa ajụjụ ya.
englishText: Mosquito followed people, still asking his question.
statement: Dad says Mosquito started following people and kept asking his question.
falseStatement: Dad says Mosquito stopped following people and stayed quiet.

speaker: granddaughter
igboText: Ọ bụ ya mere ha ji eme ụzụ n'akụkụ ntị?
englishText: Is that why they buzz near ears?
statement: The granddaughter asks if that is why mosquitoes buzz near ears.
falseStatement: The granddaughter asks if that is why mosquitoes fly to trees.

speaker: dad
igboText: Ọ bụ ihe akụkọ ochie na-ekwu.
englishText: That's what the old story says.
statement: Dad says that is what the old story says.
falseStatement: Dad says the old story says the opposite.

speaker: granddaughter
statement: The granddaughter asks what the lesson is.
falseStatement: The granddaughter asks where the story happened.

speaker: dad
igboText: Mgbe mmadụ kwuru mba, gee ntị ma gaa n'ihu.
englishText: When people say no, listen and move on.
statement: Dad says we should listen and move on when someone says no.
falseStatement: Dad says we should ignore people when they say no.

speaker: dad
igboText: Ọ bụrụ na ị laghachi ugboro ugboro, ha ga-agbalị iti gị! 😄
englishText: Keep returning, and they'll try to swat you! 😄
statement: Dad jokes that if you keep returning, people will try to swat you.
falseStatement: Dad jokes that if you keep returning, people will always welcome you.
